lead_raw_text:
The structure of K4Cr2O8 (reduced formula K2CrO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies chromium centers in octahedral coordination by six oxygen neighbors, while potassium centers show eight oxygen neighbors and oxygen centers have four geometric neighbors. Corner-sharing between Cr octahedra is observed, along with corner- and edge-sharing between Cr octahedra and K polyhedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
